empathy.fallback: Thank you for sharing your concerns. I fully understand the kind of change you're hoping for.
empathy.multi: You're considering improvements across {areas}. A combined approach can bring more harmonious overall results.

eyes.default: The eyes are central to first impressions — even a small change can shift the whole atmosphere. I understand your concerns completely.
eyes.doubleEyelid: I fully understand your wish for a natural double eyelid line. This is one of the most consulted concerns among Asian clients.
eyes.eyelines: You've been bothered by an overly intense or tired-looking gaze. Many people start consultations for the same reason.
eyes.underEye: Hollowing or protruding fat under the eyes can make you look more tired and aged than you are. I understand.

nose.default: The shape of your nose has been affecting your overall facial balance. The nose is one of the most influential features for facial impression.

lifting.default: Facial line changes with age are a natural process. Still, the stress you feel is completely understandable.

skin.default: Skin condition is directly tied to self-confidence. I fully empathize with your concerns.

education.fallback: Korea offers world-class expertise across cosmetic procedures. Finding the approach best suited to your situation is generally the most important consideration.
education.multi: Combining procedures across {areas} can be more efficient in terms of recovery time and cost.

eyes.default: Eye surgery includes various methods — buried, partial-incision, full-incision — and the right approach depends on skin thickness, eyelid drooping, and your desired line. Comparing consultations from multiple clinics is recommended.
eyes.doubleEyelid: The buried method recovers quickly and looks natural; the incision method gives a more defined and longer-lasting result. The right choice depends on skin thickness and fat volume — comparing opinions from multiple clinics is recommended.
eyes.eyelines: In Korea, non-incisional ptosis correction or forehead lifts are commonly considered to soften the gaze naturally. The key is finding a method that fits your current eye structure rather than forcing a dramatic change.
eyes.underEye: Under-eye fat repositioning doesn't remove fat — it redistributes it evenly. It can address dark circles and hollowing simultaneously, with a relatively quick recovery.

nose.default: Rhinoplasty isn't just about raising the bridge — both the tip shape and the bridge line must be adjusted together for a natural result. Korea commonly considers natural rhinoplasty using autologous cartilage.

lifting.default: Thread lifts deliver lifting effects without incisions and offer faster recovery. Ultrasound lifting like Ulthera is non-invasive and improves skin elasticity. The best method depends on the degree of sagging.

skin.default: Korean dermatology combines lasers, peels, and regenerative treatments. Personalized protocols matched to skin type and concerns are typically prioritized.

analysis.disclaimer: Actual suitability is determined through in-person consultation and diagnosis at the clinic.

eye_non_incisional_ptosis.name: Non-incisional ptosis correction
eye_non_incisional_ptosis.description: Naturally enhances the strength of opening the eyes for a softer gaze. Performed without incision, with relatively quick recovery.

forehead_lift.name: Forehead lift
forehead_lift.description: Lifts the forehead line to naturally refresh the eye area, with the additional benefit of improving forehead wrinkles.

eye_buried_suture.name: Buried-suture double eyelid
eye_buried_suture.description: Creates the eyelid line with sutures only — no incision. Quick recovery and a natural-looking result.

eye_partial_incision.name: Partial incision
eye_partial_incision.description: Combines the strengths of buried and incision methods, offering moderate definition with lasting hold.

eye_full_incision.name: Full-incision double eyelid
eye_full_incision.description: Creates a more defined and longer-lasting line. Generally considered when the skin is thicker.

under_eye_fat_repositioning.name: Under-eye fat repositioning
under_eye_fat_repositioning.description: Redistributes under-eye fat evenly rather than removing it — addressing dark circles and hollowing simultaneously, with relatively quick recovery.

lower_blepharoplasty.name: Lower blepharoplasty
lower_blepharoplasty.description: Refines the under-eye skin and fat together for a clearer, more youthful look.

nose_tip.name: Nose tip plasty
nose_tip.description: Naturally adjusts the shape and projection of the nasal tip — a key factor in overall nose balance.

nose_autologous_cartilage.name: Autologous cartilage rhinoplasty
nose_autologous_cartilage.description: Uses your own cartilage for a natural nose line without foreign-body sensation.

nose_bridge_implant.name: Nose bridge implant
nose_bridge_implant.description: Augments the bridge using silicone or Gore-Tex — a commonly considered method.

thread_lift.name: Thread lift
thread_lift.description: A non-incisional lift that uses specialized threads to lift skin and stimulate collagen. Recovery is relatively quick.

ulthera.name: Ulthera
ulthera.description: A non-invasive ultrasound-based lift, expected to improve elasticity in deeper skin layers.

hifu.name: HIFU
hifu.description: A non-surgical lifting option that improves skin elasticity using high-intensity focused ultrasound.

facial_contouring.name: Facial contouring
facial_contouring.description: Surgery that reshapes the facial bone structure to refine the overall facial line. Requires thorough consultation.

laser_toning.name: Laser toning
laser_toning.description: A laser treatment that evens out skin tone and reduces pigmentation.

fraxel.name: Fraxel
fraxel.description: Promotes skin regeneration with fractional laser, expected to improve scars and pores.

liposuction.name: Liposuction
liposuction.description: Directly removes fat from targeted areas. The approach varies by location and volume.
